Members of Nepal’s Armed Police Force worked through mud and wreckage before reaching the child, identified in reports as Manisha, and safely pulling her from the destruction. 🙏 The girl received immediate medical assistance and was reportedly transferred to Kathmandu for further care. Welcome to Gai Jatra - which literally translates to cow festival.  There’s a huge historical story behind it which is too long to explain here but essentially people originally took cows through the street as a way of saying  final goodbye to their loved ones but now for practicality they use these giant effigies call Tahamacha. November 14, 2026 Gorkha District, Nepal A large dry landslide occurred in Gorkha District. A mass of earth and rock collapsed from the Gundrung Pakha slope into the Thado Bharyang forest area near Yarubagar. Rocks began falling as early as Friday night, and the main landslide took place around 8:30 a.m., kicking up a massive cloud of dust. Debris reached the Budhi Gandaki River. The landslide blocked both a motorable road and a foot trail. According to the district police, there were no casualties or material damage.
